descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B09 · P1 · 新

点 Dictate 后立刻显示「Listening…」，但麦克风还没打开，这段时间说的话录不进去（开头的「no」被吞掉，意思可能会反）

票：TFA-94423 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：原归「要人拍板」，改判为 bug；测试里窗口约 0.05–0.1 秒，真实网络下更长

思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S10 「实时状态：就绪前就说话、一个框两次口述、'Transcribing…' 时离开或切换、第二个 Dictate、双击、提前 Stop、快速循环」 Live states: talking before ready, two takes in one box, leaving or switching while 'Transcribing…', a second Dictate, double tap, early Stop, rapid cycles

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 3）
  • T6 No dictated fact is silently dropped (Principle 2), including the last words before Stop and the words around an interruption or a recovery.（TFA-94229 R9） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U8 Dictation never leaves the physician waiting with nothing: a start or finish that fails is retried and then shown as a clear message, and the AI call time is logged separately from the total.（UAT 3.5）
  • T3 Dictation does not crash the tab.（TFA-94423 AC 8）
  • T9 A live session that fails to connect is retried once; one that drops mid-dictation keeps its recording and transcribes it once with whisper-1, the audio is kept until the transcript is in the field, …（TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 AC 6；TFA-94745 Quinn 2026-10-05 comment）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Hospital patients A and B and Nursing Home residents C and D, live engine; the Hospital pre-round box unless a cell names another surface

When (a) The voice starts 0.5 s after the Dictate tap, before ready; (b) H-03 then H-05 as two takes into the same box (also the NH Pre-Round box and NH Encounter); (c) Stop on H-04, open patient B while 'Transcribing…' shows, then come back (also from Hospital Important Points, encounter notes, 'Start bedside recording', …

Then (a) until the session is ready nothing on the surface says 'Listening…' and a wait message is visible, and every word after ready is in the box; (b) both takes present, in order, once each, the first unchanged; (c) H-04 lands once in A's box (or a Recover control there lands it once), B's pre-round box, Important Points and encounter notes hold none of H-04 …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U1 checks per take; T6: no word after ready missing, no take lost or doubled, and nothing written into another patient's, context's or field's box (the test-design 'data from another patient/context' risk); U8: the wait state is visible while words would be lost. …

在哪跑：本地 aicheck-dictation（口述 AI 检查）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94423 ready for qa；TFA-94745 ready for qa；TFA-94229 in progress

点 Dictate 后马上显示「Listening…」，但麦克风其实还没开，医生在之后 0.5–1.5 秒里说的话录不进去。

Tapping Dictate shows 'Listening…' right away while the microphone is still off, so the first words a physician says in the next 0.5–1.5 s are not recorded.

依据：allure-results/017198c6…: 11/13 pass. Both pre-round editors show 'Listening…' while the mic is still muted and the Hearing line says 'Preparing dictation…' (Hospital: 56 samples over 1.5 s; NH: 17 samples over 0.4 s). Words said in that gap are not recorded. This is the open TC-23 Q15; a matrix risk predicted it.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane aicheck-dictation。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：aicheck-dictation。

怎么测（aicheck-dictation/plan.json，automatable: yes）：scripted far end: (a) snapshot header + Hearing line 0.5 s after tap, before the mic track is enabled; (b) two takes into one box; (c) leave for patient B while 'Transcribing...' and back, read every box on A and B; (d) Dictate in Important Points while pre-round is listening; (e) switch context while 'Transcribing...'; (f) double click Dictate: decided only 'never a second session' (≤ 1 prepareSession call, ≤ 1 peer); the end state (idle/listening, sessions, mic) is recorded and 'exactly one live session' is record-only until Quinn decides whether a double tap may cancel; (g) Stop before ready; (h) 10 quick Dictate/Stop pairs with tabAlive, RTCPeerConnection count, mic released. — All cells are the app's own state handling; the far end's words are scripted, which the oracles here do not judge.

Detail:

Scripted far end: every cell here is the app's own state handling. 11/13 decided cells pass; failing: (a) hospital pre-round: nothing says 'Listening…' until the microphone is live; a wait message shows (3 samples over 53 ms before the mic was enabled; header said 'Listening…' in 3; Hearing line then: ["Hearing:Preparing dictation……"]; headers: ["Listening…"]); (a) nursing-home Pre-Round: nothing says 'Listening…' until the microphone is live; a wait message shows (5 samples over 108 ms before the mic was enabled; header said 'Listening…' in 5; Hearing line then: ["Hearing:Preparing dictation……"]; headers: ["Listening…"]); not decided here: (a) 'every word after ready is in the box' needs the live engine; (c) on Hospital Important Points, encounter notes, 'Start bedside recording' and NH Encounter not built in this pass Note on (a): with prepareSession stubbed the muted window between the tap and the microphone going live is only ~50–110 ms here; the earlier run with the real prepareSession showed 'Listening…' over 441–1547 ms of muted microphone, which is the window a physician would talk into. Record-only (needs a decision): (f) hospital: double-tap Dictate — exactly one live session (record-only until Quinn decides whether a double tap may cancel) — 4 s after the double tap the box was idle (Dictate shown); header "Pre-round notes"; prepareSession calls 1 (stub); peer connections created 0, open 0; microphone enabled false; one live session: false. prepareSession: 26 call(s), 26 stubbed at the socket, 0 real OpenAI mint(s) with …PUMA. Build e02167f; aiProvider:_current {"model":"us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0","provider":"bedrock","transcription":"gpt-live","visionModel":"gemini-2.5-flash","visionProvider":"vertex"}.

产品问题：Tapping Dictate in the hospital pre-round and the nursing-home Pre-Round editor shows 'Listening…' in the header at once, while the microphone is still muted and the Hearing line says 'Preparing dictation…'; words spoken on 'Listening…' before the session is ready are not recorded. Breaks the S10 (a) oracle (no 'Listening…' until the microphone is live) — UAT 3.5 'never left waiting with nothing' / TFA-94423 AC 8; open question Q15.

证据：附了 15 个；没附 1 个：

  • aicheck-dictation/artifacts/20261014-fix-client-stub/pw/tc23-client-TC-23-S10-live-eb908-tap-early-Stop-rapid-cycles-dictation/trace.zip — .zip 文件不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
